reference: pixels at 1080 screen lines (tip::unit() = screen height / 1080); scale everything by height/1080

opacity.note: every ink the card draws (text, marks, ring, rules, foot) has its alpha x0.94; the body gradient is not faded

fonts.heavy: the same Alegreya Sans Medium printed twice, the second 0.5 px to the right (max(0.5, 0.45 x unit)): a faux bold. On the web: font-weight 700 of Alegreya Sans, or -webkit-text-stroke 0.45px
fonts.drop: every line is printed over its own shadow: 1 px right and 1 px down (max(1, unit)), black at 0.75 alpha; text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.75)

body.note: a vertical gradient over the whole card, rounded 4; tip::ink::kBodyTop / kBodyFoot

grain.note: controls::grain: the 128 px stone tile laid 1:1 over the body inset 1 px (a texel a pixel, point-sampled, repeated); its alpha darkens or lifts what is under it

edge.note: a band from 1 to 2 px outside the body
a band from 0 to 1 px outside the body, graded top to foot

card.css: border-radius:4px; background:linear-gradient(rgba(13,10,8,.92),rgba(5,3,3,.90)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px (iron gradient: use a 1px border-image linear-gradient(#6b5645f0,#2a2019f0)), 0 0 0 2px #000, 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.7), 0 8px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.55), 0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.55)

shadow.note: three Gaussian falloffs summed and clamped at 0.85, cut away under the card (the card is glass); CSS blur = 2 x sigma

head_tint.note: a band over the head (title+subtitle+bound+2 pads tall), the name's tone at 0.13 x 0.94 alpha at the top fading to clear at its foot; top corners rounded 4

head_line.note: a 2 px line along the top edge (from y = -1), from x = 4 to width - 4, the name's tone at 0.85 x 0.94 alpha in the middle fading to clear at both ends (two linear halves)

card.placement: centred over the hovered item's cells, its bottom 10 px above their top; if no room it drops 10 px below, and with room for neither it stands beside (the side with more room); kept 4 px inside the screen
card.hover: shown while the pointer rests on an item (never during a drag); the bag turns the hovered model; values get a delta against the worn piece (good #7fd48b, bad #e2685f, same #969a8e) at 13 px, right-aligned

picture.note: item card: the item's own 3D picture, square 96 x artScale (0.2-1), at the head's right: right edge 6 px in from the card's right, top 6 px down; the name wraps at width - pad*2 - 0.6 x picture

head.note: head height = title lines x 21 + subtitle 22 + bound 21 + 24 (pad above and below); the title starts 12 px down, at x 12

breakdown.figure: heavy, figureTone or the label ink #c4c1b4

bar.note: from 3 px below the first breakdown line's top to 3 px above the last one's foot (0.15 and 0.3 of a 21 px line)

breakdown.after: 12 px under the last breakdown (railPad x 1.5)

kinds.body_top: the sections start at max(head + headline block, 6 + picture + 4)

rule.note: each section opens with it, then 8 px of air; each section ends with 8 px of air

option.compose: keyword + ' · ' + text + ' ' + tail, wrapped together at 297 px (346 - 37 - 12)
option.tail: heavy, the tone a third of the way to white (35%)
option.mark: in a 16 px gutter at x 12: centre x 20, centre y the line's middle; glyph 8 px (Ring/RingSet 18)

prose.note: a free line with no mark

stat.label: label ink #c4c1b4 or labelTone
stat.values: several stack a line each, right-aligned; a chip is an outlined box, 11 px, tracking 0.08em

gap.note: a row with gap gets 9 px of air above it (round(14 x 1.5 x 0.45))

framed.note: a framed section (a set's block): fill white 0.03, 1 px outline white 0.10, from x 31 to width - 6 (textX - 6, textWide + 12), 4 px inside the section's air; its rows indent 6 px more, a marked row's mark stands at the frame's left (x 37 + 6 = 43) and its text after 21 px

foot.left: who lines from x 12: the class line first (Green when he may, Red when not), then each requirement (quiet: met, foot ink #7d8077; Red: unmet)
foot.right: right-aligned at width - 12: the wear (with its ring), the note, keep lines, the price

ring.centre: 6 px + radius left of the words, y = baseline - 0.33 x 13
ring.arc: what is left (worn 0-1), from 12 o'clock clockwise, in ringTone or the lettering ink #e6dbc2

coin.note: MU's Zen coin (bag_zen) to the figure's left

Ring.what: an empty socket: three lozenges (width 0.8 x height)

RingSet.what: a set socket: the Ring with the Rune of Creation's two inks in it, and in game the rune's own 3D picture over it

Blade.what: a blade on the diagonal with its guard (section marks on other cards)

Shield.what: square shoulders down to a point

marks.colour: markTone, x0.94 alpha; the Ring/RingSet keep their own colours

quality_ladder: the name's tone (describe.cpp qualityOf): Rune of Creation RuneLegendary/RuneAncient, excellent Green (a legendary green), socketed Rare blue, +7 and jewels Artifact gold, luck/skill/option Uncommon (white), else White; quest items Quest violet
